# DSH Studio v0.9.8

## New features

- Query official Harness releases and install an exact selected version with isolated installation and real Profile/Host startup verification.
- Preserve the last verified selection, legacy runtime markers, and the previous runtime when a candidate fails.

## Fixes and security

- Pin Harness family packages and required peers together, preventing mixed-version export failures during downgrades.
- Serialize installation against plugin mutations, report catalog/compatibility errors, and support newer exported CLI entry points on older Node releases.
- Preserve bootstrap tokens for navigation while redacting logs and tray labels. Authentication is never disabled.

## Installation and limitations

- Upgrade in place or use the in-app updater; Full includes offline dependencies, while Lite downloads them when needed.
- The Studio baseline remains `0.1.1-rc.2`. Strict-cookie releases including `0.1.2-rc.1` and `0.1.5-rc.2` are rejected because the current embedded window cannot authenticate them. Existing runtime and user data are retained.

## Verification

- Windows cold baseline install and selected `0.1.1-rc.1` Profile startup were exercised; browser testing reproduced the strict-cookie embedding failure.
- Three-platform CI now includes selected-version boot and incompatible-version rejection. No physical Apple device was available for validation.
